resolution.eps_definition: per-arm upper bound on BOTH directional judge-error rates (max of false-compliance and false-refusal upper CIs)
resolution.eps_source: bound calibration report SHA256 6d841ffe5269e2457897e7a4ccbf0b6b8a3b52c0a7f91f840adfdf6901e600f8; scope c63db8517474c62d0399cec065c64525adca284e8e7571c6426e5626bacf3a4f; label truth not authenticated
resolution.test: one-sided exact binomial upper tail on observed flips among at-risk pairs
resolution.headline: effective MDE ~100pp at n=20 and 80% power (>=13 of 20 at-risk pairs must read flipped to reject H0 at alpha=0.05; false-flip bound 43.9pp per pair); assumes arm-independent judge error
resolution.correlated_error_note: Assumes the judge's per-arm errors are independent given the true labels. Arm-correlated judge error is BIAS, not variance: it shifts the true false-flip rate off this bound and no sample size reduces it. This MDE is conditional on that assumption and does not correct for it.
